requirement: App Statistic keeps downloads anonymous, preserves install linkage and filtered server totals

oracle.invariant: Only accepted staff seats can read list and detail; anonymous records never expose another account history. Download GET requests are deduplicated within the recorded retry window; HEAD, range and update ZIP requests do not count, and recorder failures do not block download. Public header/query claims never assign account or install ownership to sessionless downloads. Server totals remain consistent with filters and pages beyond 500 installs; downloads never enrich account aggregates, version updates retain the same install and resolved issues no longer count as attention. Account acquisition and legacy activity use verified account ownership, without assigning a source to anonymous downloads or installs.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
